Subject: Point Explanation from Natasha our Amex Rep 
Fri 2/1/2019 2:40:17 PM 
Hi Rich...wanted you to have the below from Natasha re points: 
To pay with points for upgrade - you book coach ticket and pay difference in fare (plus possible 
change fee) in points. Or you pay fro business/first class ticket partially with points (20% back), let's 
say you pay coach value with money and the rest - difference - in points, to avoid change fee. 
1.00 = 100 points.
